name: credo-ts-openbao
description: OpenBao Transit key management backend for Credo (KMS plug-in)

scripts.fmt: bun fmt --no-script src test scripts package.json bunfig.toml
scripts.fmt:check: bun fmt --check --no-script src test scripts package.json bunfig.toml
scripts.bom:sbom: npm exec --yes --package=@cyclonedx/cyclonedx-npm@6.0.1 -- cyclonedx-npm --spec-version 1.6 --output-format json --output-file sbom/sbom.cdx.json --package-lock-only --output-reproducible --validate --flatten-components --mc-type library
scripts.bom: mkdir -p sbom && npm run bom:sbom && npm run bom:cbom && npm run bom:finalize && npm run bom:validate && npm run bom:package
scripts.ci: bun run fmt:check && bun run check && bun run test && bun run build
